rows.note: Use 嚟緊 as the everyday all-purpose choice for an event that is approaching or about to happen.

example.english: The company anniversary dinner is forthcoming.
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 zau1 nin4 maan5 jin3 lei4 gan2 laa3

rows.note: Use 到位 when money, resources, or arrangements have been put in place and are available when needed.

example.english: The funding is forthcoming, so we can start work now.
example.traditional: 筆撥款已經到位，而家可以開工喇。
example.jyutping: bat1 but6 fun2 ji5 ging1 dou3 wai2 ji4 gaa1 ho2 ji5 hoi1 gung1 laa3

rows.note: Use 爽快 for someone who readily and frankly answers questions or provides information.

example.english: The witness was forthcoming and willing to tell us everything.
example.traditional: 個證人好爽快，乜都肯講。
example.jyutping: go3 zing3 jan4 hou2 song2 faai3 mat1 dou1 hang2 gong2
